dict.string: OffGrid AI FieldGuide uses the camera only when you take a photo or record a video. After confirmation, selected photos or frames go through Render and OpenRouter to NextBit, Venice, Parasail, or Novita for Gemma 4 analysis, with Google Cloud Vertex AI only if all four fail.

OffGrid AI FieldGuide uses the microphone only to record video or when you tap Voice Input. Recorded-video audio is not uploaded. Apple Speech Recognition may process dictated audio; the resulting text is sent for AI processing only after you submit it.
OffGrid AI FieldGuide uses Apple Speech Recognition only when you tap Voice Input. The resulting text is sent through the disclosed fixed iOS AI route only if you choose to submit the question.

OffGrid AI FieldGuide lets you choose photos and videos. After confirmation, selected photos or frames go through Render and OpenRouter to NextBit, Venice, Parasail, or Novita for Gemma 4 analysis, with Google Cloud Vertex AI only if all four fail.
OffGrid AI FieldGuide can save generated visuals and field guides to your phone when you choose Save.
OffGrid AI FieldGuide uses motion sensors only when you tap the compass for a heading.
